name: IHG One Rewards Credit Card
balance_transfer_fee: Either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater
penalty_apr_trigger: Failing to make a Minimum Payment when due, or making a payment that's returned unpaid; can remain in effect indefinitely
pay_over_time_fee: Up to 1.72% per month of the amount selected to pay over time, via Chase Pay Over Time

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $2,000 in purchases in the first 3 months from account opening

verdict.text: Free IHG points earner, upgraded with World Elite perks in 2025

earn_note: 2× on general spend is unusually strong for a no-fee card, and the 3× bucket (dining, gas, groceries) is broad enough to hit most months. Utilities, internet, cable, phone and select streaming also earn 3× through Dec 31, 2026, then drop to 2×. The Premier card earns faster at IHG hotels (10× vs 5×) and on dining, groceries and gas (5× vs 3×), but this card asks nothing back for it.

points.note: Same IHG One Rewards currency as the Premier card (NerdWallet valued points around 0.6¢ in 2026). This card just earns it for free, without the Premier's anniversary free night certificate or Platinum status. Never transfer to airlines; the ~5:1 ratio guts the value.

transfer_partners.highlight: IHG One Rewards transfers to 37 airline partners, mostly at a 5:1 ratio (5,000 IHG points → 1,000 miles); transfers must be initiated by phone, not online.
transfer_partners.recent_changes: Verified directly against IHG’s live partner page: El Al Matmid is no longer listed as a partner (previously reported as one by some trackers), while China Eastern, Finnair, and Lufthansa (Miles & More) are current partners not previously captured here.

partners.name: Air Miles
partners.notes: Reduced ratio, well below the 5:1 standard.

partners.name: Air New Zealand Airpoints
partners.notes: Reduced ratio, well below the 5:1 standard.

credits.name: Annual Spend Bonus
credits.subtitle: 10,000 pts · after $15,000/yr spend
credits.description: 10,000 bonus IHG One Rewards points each calendar year you spend at least $15,000 on the card.
tips: Only count this if you're already going to hit $15,000/yr; the points aren't worth chasing the spend on their own.

credits.name: Instacart Credit
credits.subtitle: $10/mo · up to $120/yr · + 3-mo Instacart+
credits.description: A complimentary 3-month Instacart+ trial plus up to $10 in monthly Instacart credits (through Dec 31, 2027). Requires an active Instacart+ membership to receive the monthly credit.
tips: Remember to cancel Instacart+ after the trial if you don't want to keep paying for it.
$0 to you if you don't already grocery-shop through Instacart.

credits.name: DoorDash DashPass + Credit
credits.subtitle: 12-mo complimentary + $10/mo non-restaurant
credits.description: One year of complimentary DashPass membership (DoorDash and Caviar) plus $10 off per month on non-restaurant DoorDash orders for DashPass activated from Sep 1, 2026 (quarterly before that). This figure counts the discount, not the membership.
tips: Requires activation and payment with this card at checkout to earn the quarterly credit.

credits.name: 4th Reward Night Free
credits.subtitle: on 4+ consecutive award nights, same property
credits.description: On any reward-night stay of 4 or more consecutive nights at the same property, the 4th night is free (unlimited redemptions per year). Starting in 2027, it needs $5,000 in purchases in a calendar year to unlock.
tips: Only pays off on award stays already 4+ nights long; not a general-purpose credit.
$100 here is a rough single-stay estimate.

insurance.detail: $60,000 · secondary in the US, primary abroad

protection_note: Unusually complete protections for a $0 card: trip cancellation and auto rental coverage are both here, alongside baggage delay, lost luggage, purchase protection, extended warranty and travel accident insurance. The limits match the paid Premier's and trail any premium travel card.
rental_note: Auto Rental Coverage is included: decline the counter waiver, pay for the whole rental with the card, and it reimburses theft and collision damage. Secondary to your own policy in the US.

status_perks.name: IHG One Rewards Silver Elite Status
status_perks.note: Complimentary with the card for as long as you hold it: a light welcome amenity and modest bonus points. Gold Elite unlocks after $15,000 in card spend in a calendar year, lasting through December 31 of the following year.

services.name: Mastercard World Elite Benefits
services.detail: Lyft ride credits, Booking.com prepaid-stay discounts (up to 7% off), Zero Liability protection, and other World Elite Mastercard perks, added July 24, 2025.

services.name: Points purchase discount
services.detail: At least 30% off when buying IHG One Rewards points directly with this card.

services.name: Early access to IHG Reward Night sales
services.detail: Cardmembers get early access to IHG's Reward Night sales each year.

additional_cards.title: Authorized Users

benefits.text: Earns IHG One Rewards points on their spend (into your account)
Does not get their own Silver status independently

additional_cards.note: Authorized users are free to add.

timeline.text: Renamed the IHG One Rewards Credit Card. Groceries join the 3× bucket, while utilities, internet, cable, phone and streaming drop to 2× after Dec 31, 2026. From 2027 the 4th Reward Night Free requires $5,000 in annual spend.
The $10 DoorDash non-restaurant promo moves from quarterly to monthly for DashPass activated on or after this date.

Card network upgraded from standard Mastercard to Mastercard World Elite for new and existing cardholders, adding Lyft, Booking.com, and other World Elite perks on top of the existing IHG earning structure, with no fee change.
Instacart ($10/mo credit + 3-month Instacart+ trial) and DashPass benefits added, active through Dec 31, 2027.
IHG Rewards Club program and cards rebranded to IHG One Rewards.
